notes.title: 🔧 Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
⚙️ New Tutorialversion deployed 0.6.5
⭐️ = community feedback



You guys complained a lot that our tutorial didn't teach you anything. We thought it would be easy to teach you all the mechanics just by playing the game, but we realize that's a lot to expect while driving at full speed through a gigantic rift! We have overhauled the current tutorial and added text boxes and flashy images to explain everything. We hope this does the job — if not, join our Discord server and let us know why. We love the feedback you're giving us, and we love implementing your ideas.



Oh, and we've also updated some other things in the game.


New Features
⭐️ major tutorial improvements

added progress menu to garage and tutorial menu

⭐️ added keyboard navigation for ui tab navigation

added more new chunks to biome 1

added new ad banner colors


Balancing
increased juice gain slightly

removed scrap drops from ad sails

reduced scrap cost increase in the pitstop during a run

reduced cost of some parts in the pitstop during a run

adjusted some parts of the map to be more fair


Bugfixes
fixed slower obstacle mod not working properly


Quality of life
inventory now shows both cards (of equipped and selected part)

equipped parts in inventory are properly highlighted on selection

⭐️ looting an empty part-box will now also show a card pop-up

improved pitstop UI layout

⭐️ changed the color of default part icons in inventories to make them more distinguishable from other parts



Again: If you find any bugs, want to give feedback or have some nice Ideas to make the game even better, feel free to join us on Discord and let us know.

Gino & Linus

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update | Patch 0.6.5
notes.notes:
⚙️ New version deployed 0.6.5
⭐️ = community feedback



We've listened to your feedback and added some new quality-of-life improvements to our game. Highlights include an updated inventory and new skills and upgrades.


New Features
skill upgrades are now communicated more clearly in Skill chunks, the pitstop, and the Pause Menu

added new Salt Lake chunks (Biome 1)

scrap costs are increased with each consecutive pitstop

⭐️ cacti now give Juice


Bug Fixes
⭐️ fixed an issue where parts could be equipped in the background when progressing in the reward menu after a run

⭐️ fixed screenshake stacking

fixed juice and scrap loot colliding with drive camera

fixed a bug where the tutorial reward mod would disappear


Balancing
adjusted all scrap costs in the pitstop

reduced Juice gain overall


Quality of Life
⭐️ improved inventory UI to make equipped items more visible

added a Pause Menu pop-up for “Quit Game” or “Give Up Run” confirmation


Misc
improved chunks (level-design)

adjusted background in main menu


⚠️ Known Issues
closing give up or quit menu with controller will also close pause menu at the same time

vSync enabled can cause lags

some graphics settings override each other

open pause will reset invincibility timer

no proper widescreen support



If you have any feedback for us, please get in touch – for example, via Discord.

Gino & Linus

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update | Patch 0.6.4
notes.notes:
⚙️ New version deployed 0.6.4
⭐️ = community feedback



Thank you for all the feedback that you have provided via Discord, Steam and other media. We're thrilled to see so many people enjoying the SCHROTT demo. Since we want the demo to be in the best possible state, we are releasing a new update right now!


New Features
added a reward mod and part for completing the tutorial

added 4 new world-chunks (level-design)

⭐️ added a graphics tab to options


Mayor Bug Fixes
⭐️ fixed vanishing parts after run complete and looting/reward logic

⭐️ fixed equipping first part in inventory after buying a part in pit stop with same input

fixed boulder vanishing sometimes when shooting in quick succession

fixed sudden mute on run finish


Balancing
driving close to non damageable obstacles does not give juice anymore

adjusted some level-design (world-chunks)

⭐️ skills now have more balanced cooldowns

player exp progression is now curved instead of linear

boost now only costs juice once not per second anymore

rebalanced speed mods

moving obstacle press movement is now linear

pitstop part shop is now connected to internal drop chances

skill upgrades can now have cooldown reductions


Other Bug Fixes
⭐️ fixed rig randomly rotating in pitstop inventory view

⭐️ disabled cam shake in pause screen

fixed speed mod reset after equipping a part in pitstop

fixed equip part sound to only fire when parts are actually equipped or bought

disabled mods while in tutorial

fixed some world-chunks (level-design)


Misc
⭐️ adjusted pit stop UI for widescreen (still not fully supported)

added 60-FPS fallback to save and load

⭐️ adjusted options toggle selections

improved result screen


⚠️ Known Issues
skill upgrades are not communicated properly

vSync enabled can cause lags

some graphics settings override each other

open pause menu will reset invincibility timer

no settings to disable motion blur or depth of field


That's all for now! Next, we will address the known issues and continue working on content for the full release.
